vulnerabilities.desc: Potential SQL Injection signature in URL; database behavior not tested.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries and least-privilege database accounts.

vulnerabilities.desc: Potential SSRF to internal resource; server-side request not verified.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Allowlist destinations; validate resolved IPs and every redirect.

checks.desc: Token present, or no forms found; server-side validation not verified.
checks.remediation: Validate CSRF tokens server-side; use SameSite cookies and verify Origin.
